title: Equipment Rental and Demo Agreements Held Against One Household Account
content:
## One agreement for each rider

A household account carries a separate rental agreement for every rider, because kit is fitted to one body and one ability level. A family of four hiring together holds four agreements on one account, each with its own sizes, its own security hold and its own dates.

The account may carry several live agreements at once, up to 6. Agreements standing reserved, confirmed, picked up and overdue count towards that number. Agreements that have reached returned, cancelled, uncollected or closed no longer count against the account.

Two live agreements for the same rider over overlapping dates are never opened; where the guest wants a second package for the same rider on the same dates the first agreement is changed rather than a second one added.

### What the desk works from

Whether a live agreement already stands for that rider over those dates is settled on the collective's own records, read before the new agreement is opened, and not on the guest's account of what they hold. The records are matched on three things together: the household account, the rider named on the agreement, and the collection date. Where the match is made, the agreements already standing are weighed only if they stand reserved, confirmed, picked up or overdue.

Agreements that are properly separate records against one account for one rider are told apart by the package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line they are written on and by the mountain the kit is collected at.

### The same rules as a table

| Agreement standing | Counts against the 6 | Weighed when looking for a live agreement over the same dates |
| --- | --- | --- |
| reserved | yes | yes |
| confirmed | yes | yes |
| picked up | yes | yes |
| overdue | yes | yes |
| returned | no | no |
| cancelled | no | no |
| uncollected | no | no |
| closed | no | no |

### Worked examples on hypothetical accounts

**Two parents and two children hiring for the same week.** Four riders are fitted, so four agreements stand on the one household account, each carrying its own sizes, its own security hold and its own dates. Four live agreements stand against the allowance of 6.

**A household already holding six live agreements.** Six agreements standing reserved, confirmed, picked up or overdue exhaust the number this charter allows; an account holding six agreements of which two stand returned and one cancelled has three live against the allowance of 6.

**The same rider asking for a second package on the same dates.** A second live agreement is not opened for that rider over those dates. The agreement already standing for the rider on that collection date is what changes.
